set_name: 实时趋势图——pcu/acu
set_sql: SELECT logymd, point, CASE WHEN point = MAX(point) OVER( PARTITION BY logymd ) AND SUM(online_num) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(online_num) END AS online_num, MAX(pcu) AS pcu, avg(acu) AS acu FROM ( WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY logymd, country, region, point ), t_pcu AS ( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num, MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS pcu, AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point ), t_incr AS ( SELECT t2.logymd, t2.country, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point ) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd, country FROM t GROUP BY logymd, country ) t2 ), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu, online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, MAX(pcu) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS max_pcu, SUM(online_num) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT max(COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd)) AS logymd, max(COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point)) AS point, max(COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, NULL)) AS online_num, max(COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, NULL)) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point group by t_pcu.point ) t ) t ) SELECT logymd, point, online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor( ( hour(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) ) / 300 ), 512 ) ) ORDER BY logymd, point ) AS tmp GROUP BY logymd, point

set_sql: with t_mlbb_top5 as( select 'mlbb' as app_name, 0 as st_order union all( select app_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY st_downloads desc) AS st_order from( select app_name, sum(st_downloads) as st_downloads from ( select app_name, country, st_downloads from test.ads_gamebi_competitor_gamemarket_mf WHERE p = 'p' and logymd between '#{base_logymd_start}' and '#{base_logymd_end}' and app_name not in ('mlbb', 'st_gamemarket') and ${country}) a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from test.dim_country_new where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${region} group by app_name) t limit 5)) select logymd, mlbb_top5.app_name, mlbb_top5.st_order, sum(st_downloads) as st_downloads from ( select app_name, st_order from t_mlbb_top5) mlbb_top5 left outer join ( select logymd, app_name, country, st_downloads from test.ads_gamebi_competitor_gamemarket_mf where p = 'p' and ${logymd} and app_name in ( select app_name from t_mlbb_top5) and ${country}) competitor on mlbb_top5.app_name = competitor.app_name left outer join ( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from test.dim_country_new where ${definition_type}) dim on competitor.country = dim.country_code where ${region} and logymd is not null group by logymd, mlbb_top5.app_name, mlbb_top5.st_order order by mlbb_top5.st_order

set_name: 市场分析-市场TOP100游戏
set_sql: with t_base_view as( select logymd, app_name, sum(st_downloads) as st_downloads, sum(st_mau) as st_mau, sum(st_income) as st_income from( select logymd, app_name, country, st_downloads, st_mau, st_income from mt_ads.ads_gamebi_competitor_gamemarket_mf WHERE p = 'p' and logymd between '#{base_logymd_start}' and '#{base_logymd_end}' and app_name not in ('st_gamemarket') and ${country}) a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${region} group by logymd, app_name), t_united_top100 as ( select app_name, st_mau, st_downloads, st_income from ( select app_name, st_mau, st_downloads, st_income, row_number() OVER ( ORDER BY st_mau DESC) AS st_mau_rn, row_number() OVER ( ORDER BY st_downloads DESC) AS st_downloads_rn, row_number() OVER ( ORDER BY st_income DESC) AS st_income_rn from ( SELECT app_name, avg(st_mau) as st_mau, avg(st_downloads) as st_downloads, avg(st_income) as st_income FROM t_base_view group by app_name) t) t where st_mau_rn <= 100 or st_downloads_rn <= 100 or st_income_rn <= 100), t_current_view as( select logymd, app_name, sum(st_downloads) as st_downloads, sum(st_mau) as st_mau, sum(st_income) as st_income from ( select logymd, app_name, country, st_downloads, st_mau, st_income from mt_ads.ads_gamebi_competitor_gamemarket_mf WHERE p = 'p' and ${logymd} and app_name not in ('st_gamemarket') and ${country}) a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${region} group by logymd, app_name), t_agg_month_view as ( select logymd, sum(st_mau) as st_mau, sum(st_downloads) as st_downloads, sum(st_income) as st_income from t_current_view where app_name in ( select app_name from t_united_top100) or app_name in ('潮汐守望者', '决胜巅峰', 'Watcher of Realms', 'Magic Chess: Go Go') group by logymd) SELECT 'ALL' as app_name, avg(st_mau) as st_mau, avg(st_downloads) as st_downloads, avg(st_income) as st_income from t_agg_month_view union select case when app_name = 'mlbb' then 'MLBB' else app_name end as app_name, avg(st_mau) as st_mau, avg(st_downloads) as st_downloads, avg(st_income) as st_income from t_current_view where app_name in ( select app_name from t_united_top100) or app_name in ('潮汐守望者', '决胜巅峰', 'Watcher of Realms', 'Magic Chess: Go Go') group by app_name

set_name: 市场分析-MLBB重合top100游戏
set_sql: with t_base_view as( select logymd, app_name, sum(compet_act_cnt) as compet_act_cnt, sum(mlbb_act_cnt) as mlbb_act_cnt from( select logymd, app_name, country, compet_act_cnt, mlbb_act_cnt from test.ads_gamebi_competitor_account_mi WHERE logymd between '#{base_logymd_start}' and '#{base_logymd_end}' and ${country}) a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from test.dim_country_new where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${region} group by logymd, app_name ), t_top100_view as ( select app_name, compet_act_cnt from ( select app_name, compet_act_cnt, row_number() OVER ( ORDER BY compet_act_cnt DESC ) AS compet_act_cnt_rn from ( SELECT app_name, avg(compet_act_cnt) as compet_act_cnt FROM t_base_view group by app_name) t ) t where compet_act_cnt_rn <= 100 ), t_current_view as( select logymd, app_name, sum(compet_act_cnt) as compet_act_cnt, sum(mlbb_act_cnt) as mlbb_act_cnt from ( select logymd, app_name, country, compet_act_cnt, mlbb_act_cnt from test.ads_gamebi_competitor_account_mi WHERE ${logymd} and ${country} and app_name in (select app_name from t_top100_view )) a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from test.dim_country_new where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${region} group by logymd, app_name) SELECT app_name, avg(compet_act_cnt) as compet_act_cnt, sum(compet_act_cnt) / sum(mlbb_act_cnt) as compet_day_login_duration_avg FROM t_current_view group by app_name

'select review_cnt, total_review_cnt from( select 1 as join_key, avg(review_cnt) as review_cnt from ( select logymd, sum(review_cnt) as review_cnt from `test`.`ads_gamebi_public_opinion_keyword_df` where dt =( select max(dt) from `test`.`ads_gamebi_public_opinion_keyword_df`) and granularity_type = ''keyword'' and ${logymd} and ${game_name} and ${language_en} and ${category1} and ${category2} and ${keyword_en} and ${star_level} group by logymd) t) base left join ( select 1 as join_key, sum(review_cnt) as total_review_cnt from `test`.`ads_gamebi_public_opinion_keyword_df` where dt =( select max(dt) from `test`.`ads_gamebi_public_opinion_keyword_df`) and granularity_type = ''all'' and ${logymd} and ${game_name} and ${language_en} and ${star_level}) total on base.join_key = total.join_key' : (#dims.contains('logymd') ? set_sql: WITH t_dau_view AS( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(point_cnt) AS dau_point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS dau_day_cnt FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_login a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} GROUP BY logymd, point ), t_charge_view AS ( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(point_amt) AS charge_point_amt, SUM(day_amt) AS charge_day_amt FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_charge a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} GROUP BY logymd, point ), t_charge_cnt_view AS ( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(point_cnt) AS charge_point_cnt, SUM(day_cnt) AS charge_day_cnt FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_charge_cnt a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} GROUP BY logymd, point ) SELECT COALESCE(charge.logymd,dau.logymd,charge_cnt.logymd) as logymd, COALESCE(charge.point,dau.point,charge_cnt.point) as point, charge_point_amt, dau_point_cnt, charge_point_cnt, charge_day_amt, dau_day_cnt, charge_day_cnt FROM t_charge_view charge FULL JOIN t_dau_view dau ON charge.logymd = dau.logymd AND charge.point = dau.point FULL JOIN t_charge_cnt_view charge_cnt ON charge.logymd = charge_cnt.logymd AND charge.point = charge_cnt.point

and ${region} group by region, point) select region, charge_day_amt, dau_day_cnt from ( select dau.region, charge_day_amt, dau_day_cnt, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY charge.point DESC) AS rnk from set_sql: SELECT logymd, point, CASE WHEN point = MAX(point) OVER( PARTITION BY logymd ) AND SUM(online_num) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(online_num) END AS online_num, MAX(pcu) AS pcu, avg(acu) AS acu FROM ( WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view_zgame WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY logymd, country, region, point ), t_pcu AS ( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num, MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS pcu, AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point ), t_incr AS ( SELECT t2.logymd, t2.country, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point ) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd, country FROM t GROUP BY logymd, country ) t2 ), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu, online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, MAX(pcu) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS max_pcu, SUM(online_num) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd)) AS logymd, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point)) AS point, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, NULL)) AS online_num, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, NULL)) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point GROUP BY t_pcu.point ) t ) t ) SELECT logymd, point, online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor( ( hour(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) ) / 300 ), 512 ) ) ORDER BY logymd, point ) AS tmp GROUP BY logymd, point

set_sql: WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region , SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view_mla WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY logymd, country, region, point), t_pcu AS( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num , MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER(PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS pcu , AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point), t_incr AS ( SELECT t2.logymd, t2.country, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd, country FROM t GROUP BY logymd, country ) t2 ), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu , online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, max(pcu) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS max_pcu , sum(online_num) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd) AS logymd , COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point) AS point , COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, 0) AS online_num , COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, 0) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point ) t ) t ) SELECT logymd, point, online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512) ) ORDER BY logymd, point

set_sql: WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region , SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY logymd, country, region, point), t_pcu AS( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num , MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER(PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS pcu , AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point), t_incr AS ( SELECT t2.logymd, t2.country, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd, country FROM t GROUP BY logymd, country ) t2 ), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu , online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, max(pcu) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS max_pcu , sum(online_num) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd) AS logymd , COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point) AS point , COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, 0) AS online_num , COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, 0) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point ) t ) t ) SELECT logymd, point, sum(CASE WHEN original_point = max_point_in_hour THEN online_num ELSE 0 END) AS online_num, sum(CASE WHEN original_point = max_point_in_hour THEN pcu ELSE 0 END) AS pcu, sum(CASE WHEN original_point = max_point_in_hour THEN acu ELSE 0 END) AS acu FROM ( SELECT logymd, FLOOR(point / 12) AS point, point as original_point, MAX(point) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, FLOOR(point / 12)) as max_point_in_hour, MAX(online_num) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, FLOOR(point / 12)) as online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512))) AS tempView GROUP BY logymd, point

minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by country ), charge_data AS ( select country, max(day_amt) as charge_day_amt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_charge a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by country ), create_role_data AS ( select country, max(day_cnt) as create_role_day_cnt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_create_role a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by country ), recurring_data AS ( select country, max(day_cnt) as recurring_day_cnt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_recurring a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by country ), online_data AS ( SELECT country, max(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(sum(online_num) / (max(point) + 1)) AS acu FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512) ) AND ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND FULL JOIN recurring_data d ON COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country) = d.country FULL JOIN online_data e ON COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country, d.country) = e.country

a.city, a.province, b.province_key, a.online_num, a.point, -- 按分组找出point最大时的online_num ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.city, a.province, b.province_key ORDER BY a.point DESC) AS rn FROM b ON a.city = b.city_code AND a.province = b.province_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND zone_type = 1 AND ${city} AND ${province} AND ${city_level} ) where ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by logymd, point), t_view as( select COALESCE(dau.logymd, charge.logymd) as logymd, COALESCE(dau.point, charge.point) as point, charge_point_amt, dau_point_cnt, charge_day_amt, dau_day_cnt from t_charge_view charge full join t_dau_view dau on charge.logymd = dau.logymd and original_point = max_point_in_hour THEN dau_day_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS dau_day_cnt FROM ( SELECT logymd, FLOOR(point / 12) AS point, point as original_point, MAX(point) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd, set_sql: WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region , SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_nova_cube_view WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '#{zone_type}')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), set_sql: WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_zone_online a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${appname} AND ${logymd} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${region} AND ${country} AND ${zoneid} AND ${user_type} GROUP BY logymd, point), t_pcu AS( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num , MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER(PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS pcu , AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER(PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point), t_incr AS( SELECT t2.logymd, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd FROM t GROUP BY logymd) t2), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu , online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, max(pcu) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS max_pcu , sum(online_num) OVER (PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd) AS logymd , COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point) AS point , COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, 0) AS online_num , COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, 0) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point) t) t ) SELECT logymd, point, online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512) ) ORDER BY logymd, point

date_range = 'compare_date' THEN pay_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS `compare_pay_usd_amt` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN product_money ELSE 0 END) AS `base_product_money` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS `base_pay_amt` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN pay_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS `base_pay_usd_amt` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN product_money ELSE 0 END) AS `compare_product_money` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN actual_usd_amt ELSE 0 END) AS `compare_actual_usd_amt` FROM ( SELECT case when logymd BETWEEN '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' then 'base_date' else 'compare_date' end as date_range, currency , SUM(actual_usd_amt) AS actual_usd_amt , SUM(product_money) AS product_money /**分国家流水**/ , SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_amt , SUM(pay_usd_amt) AS pay_usd_amt FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code WHERE (logymd between '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' or logymd between '#{compare_start}' and '#{compare_end}') and zone_type = 0 and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${timezone_type} and ${country} and ${region} and ${bill_country} and ${sub_pay_channel} and ${pay_type} GROUP BY currency, case when logymd BETWEEN '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' then 'base_date' else 'compare_date' end) t1 GROUP BY currency) t2) t3 ) t4 ), t_influence_total as ( SELECT 'total' as currency, ((new_product_money - compare_product_money) / compare_product_money ) * (compare_actual_usd_amt / compare_product_money) as `exchange_rate_influence` FROM ( SELECT SUM(new_product_money) AS new_product_money , SUM(compare_product_money) AS compare_product_money , SUM(compare_actual_usd_amt) AS compare_actual_usd_amt from t_influence_info ) tmpView ) select currency, exchange_rate_influence * 100 as exchange_rate_influence from (( select currency, exchange_rate_influence from t_influence_info) union all ( select currency, exchange_rate_influence from t_influence_total)) as t

set_name: 支付中心维度拆解-实收率-渠道归因分析
set_sql: SELECT country, pay_channel, channel_product_money_percent_influence * 100 as channel_product_money_percent_influence, channel_actual_rate_percent_influence * 100 as channel_actual_rate_percent_influence, IF(pay_channel_type = 1, channel_product_money_percent_influence * 100, 0) as thrid_channel_product_money_percent_influence, IF(pay_channel_type = 2, channel_product_money_percent_influence * 100, 0) as inside_channel_product_money_percent_influence, IF(pay_channel_type = 1, channel_actual_rate_percent_influence * 100, 0) as thrid_channel_actual_rate_percent_influence, IF(pay_channel_type = 2, channel_actual_rate_percent_influence * 100, 0) as inside_channel_actual_rate_percent_influence FROM( SELECT country , pay_channel_type , pay_channel , base_product_money_channel_percent - compare_product_money_channel_percent AS `product_money_channel_diff` /**渠道流水份额差异**/ , base_actual_rate_country_channel - compare_actual_rate_country_channel AS `actual_rate_diff` /**渠道实收率差异**/ , (base_product_money_channel_percent - compare_product_money_channel_percent) * (compare_actual_rate_country_channel - compare_actual_rate_country) * compare_product_money_country_percent AS `channel_product_money_percent_influence` /**`渠道份额差异的影响`**/ , (base_actual_rate_country_channel - compare_actual_rate_country_channel) * base_product_money_channel_percent * base_product_money_country_percent AS `channel_actual_rate_percent_influence` /**渠道实收率差异的影响**/ FROM ( SELECT country , pay_channel_type , pay_channel , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN product_money_country_percent ELSE NULL END) AS `compare_product_money_country_percent` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN product_money_country_percent ELSE NULL END) AS `base_product_money_country_percent` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN actual_rate_country ELSE NULL END) AS `compare_actual_rate_country` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN actual_rate_country ELSE NULL END) AS `base_actual_rate_country` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN product_money_channel_percent ELSE NULL END) AS `compare_product_money_channel_percent` /**渠道流水份额**/ , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN product_money_channel_percent ELSE NULL END) AS `base_product_money_channel_percent` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN product_money ELSE NULL END) AS `compare_product_money` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN product_money ELSE NULL END) AS `base_product_money` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN actual_usd_amt ELSE NULL END) / SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'compare_date' THEN product_money ELSE NULL END) AS `compare_actual_rate_country_channel` , SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN actual_usd_amt ELSE NULL END) / SUM(CASE WHEN date_range = 'base_date' THEN product_money ELSE NULL END) AS `base_actual_rate_country_channel` FROM ( SELECT date_range , country , pay_channel_type , pay_channel , product_money / SUM(product_money) OVER (PARTITION BY date_range, country) AS product_money_channel_percent /**渠道流水份额**/ , SUM(product_money) OVER (PARTITION BY date_range, country) / SUM(product_money) OVER (PARTITION BY date_range) AS product_money_country_percent /**国家流水份额**/ , SUM(actual_usd_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY date_range, country) / SUM(product_money) OVER (PARTITION BY date_range, country) AS actual_rate_country /**国家实收率**/ , actual_usd_amt , product_money FROM ( SELECT case when logymd BETWEEN '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' then 'base_date' else 'compare_date' end as date_range, country , pay_channel_type , pay_channel , SUM(product_money) AS product_money /**分国家渠道流水**/ , SUM(actual_usd_amt) AS actual_usd_amt /**分国家渠道美金实收金额**/ FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code WHERE (logymd between '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' or logymd between '#{compare_start}' and '#{compare_end}') and zone_type = 0 and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${timezone_type} and ${country} and ${region} and ${bill_country} and ${sub_pay_channel} and ${pay_type} GROUP BY country, case when logymd BETWEEN '#{base_start}' and '#{base_end}' then 'base_date' else 'compare_date' end, pay_channel_type, pay_channel) t1) t2 GROUP BY country, pay_channel_type, pay_channel) t3) t4

set_name: 离线卡牌PRO按DAU排序渠道TOP3
set_sql: WITH base_data AS( select logymd, channel, sum(active_cnt) as active_cnt from mt_ads.ads_gamebi_roger_primary_di a left outer join( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${region} and ${country} and ${network_group} and ${new_type} and ${install_label} and ${os} and ${channel} and ${network} and ${user_type} group by logymd, channel), ranked_channels AS( SELECT channel, avg(active_cnt) AS active_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY avg(active_cnt) DESC) AS channel_rank FROM base_data GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, active_cnt FROM ranked_channels where channel_rank <= 3

set_name: 支付中心用户来源桑基图
set_sql: SELECT source_node, target_node, node_lelvel, edge_value, ratio FROM ( SELECT pay_user_type AS source_node, last_pay_channel_yd_config AS target_node, 1 AS node_lelvel, count(1) AS edge_value, count(1) / SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER( PARTITION BY pay_user_type ) * 100 AS ratio FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di a WHERE ${logymd} AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'role' AND date_type = 'daily' AND timezone_type = 0 AND ${country} AND ${pay_channel_config} GROUP BY pay_user_type, last_pay_channel_yd_config UNION ALL SELECT last_pay_channel_yd_config AS source_node, pay_channel_config AS target_node, 2 AS node_lelvel, count(1) AS edge_value, count(1) / SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER( PARTITION BY last_pay_channel_yd_config ) * 100 AS ratio FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di a WHERE ${logymd} AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'role' AND date_type = 'daily' AND timezone_type = 0 AND ${country} AND ${pay_channel_config} GROUP BY last_pay_channel_yd_config, pay_channel_config UNION ALL SELECT pay_channel_config AS source_node, first_recall_pay_channel_config AS target_node, 3 AS node_level, count(1) AS edge_value, count(1) / SUM(COUNT(1)) OVER( PARTITION BY pay_channel_config ) * 100 AS ratio FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_user_channel_tz_di a WHERE ${logymd} AND appname = 'mlbb' AND granularity_type = 'role' AND date_type = 'daily' AND timezone_type = 0 AND ${country} AND ${pay_channel_config} GROUP BY pay_channel_config, first_recall_pay_channel_config ) t ORDER BY node_lelvel ASC, source_node ASC, edge_value ASC

set_sql: WITH sum_country_product_money AS ( SELECT date_range AS logymd, SUM(product_money) AS sum_country_product_money FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND zone_type = 0 AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${timezone_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${bill_country} AND ${sub_pay_channel} AND ${pay_type} GROUP BY date_range ), product_money AS ( SELECT date_range AS logymd, pay_channel_type, pay_channel, country AS linkage_country, bill_country, pay_type, roleid, product_money FROM mt_dm.dm_finance_role_zone_tz_di a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND zone_type = 0 AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${timezone_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${bill_country} AND ${sub_pay_channel} AND ${pay_type} ) SELECT a.logymd, pay_channel_type, pay_channel, a.linkage_country AS country, bill_country, pay_type, roleid, product_money, b.sum_country_product_money FROM product_money a LEFT JOIN sum_country_product_money b ON a.logymd = b.logymd WHERE ${linkage_country}

set_sql: SELECT point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num, SUM(online_num) AS pcu, SUM(SUM(online_num)) OVER () / (MAX(point) OVER() + 1) AS acu FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view WHERE point <= ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor( ( hour(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) ) / 300 ), 512 ) ) AND ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY point

mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and country <> 'us_compliance' and ${region} group by country ), charge_data AS ( select country, max(day_amt) as charge_day_amt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_charge a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and country <> 'us_compliance' and ${region} group by country ), create_role_data AS ( select country, max(day_cnt) as create_role_day_cnt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_create_role a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and country <> 'us_compliance' and ${region} group by country ), recurring_data AS ( select country, max(day_cnt) as recurring_day_cnt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_recurring a left outer join ( select region, country_type, definition_type, country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and country <> 'us_compliance' and ${region} group by country ), online_data AS ( SELECT country, max(online_num) AS pcu, ROUND(sum(online_num) / (max(point) + 1)) AS acu FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_online_cube_view_us_mobile WHERE point <= ( SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT}, floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512) ) AND ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} and country <> 'us_compliance' AND ${region} AND ${definition_type} AND ${grouping_name} GROUP BY country ) SELECT COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country, d.country, e.country) AS country, a.login_day_cnt, b.charge_day_amt, c.create_role_day_cnt, d.recurring_day_cnt, e.pcu, e.acu FROM login_data a FULL JOIN charge_data b ON a.country = b.country FULL JOIN create_role_data c ON COALESCE(a.country, b.country) = c.country FULL JOIN recurring_data d ON COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country) = d.country FULL JOIN online_data e ON COALESCE(a.country, b.country, c.country, d.country) = e.country

( WITH t AS( SELECT logymd, point, country, region, SUM(online_num) AS online_num FROM mt_ads_realtime.realtime_basic_online a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${country} AND ${region} AND ${channel} GROUP BY logymd, point, country, region ), t_pcu AS ( SELECT logymd, point, SUM(online_num) AS online_num, MAX(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS pcu, AVG(SUM(online_num)) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS acu FROM t GROUP BY logymd, point ), t_incr AS ( SELECT t2.logymd, t2.country, t1.point FROM ( SELECT point FROM mt_dim.dim_point ) t1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT logymd, country FROM t GROUP BY logymd, country ) t2 ), t_all AS ( SELECT logymd, point, online_num, max_pcu AS pcu, online_num_acu / (point + 1) AS acu FROM ( SELECT *, MAX(pcu) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS max_pcu, SUM(online_num) OVER ( PARTITION BY logymd ORDER BY point ) AS online_num_acu FROM ( SELECT MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.logymd, t_incr.logymd)) AS logymd, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.point, t_incr.point)) AS point, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.online_num, NULL)) AS online_num, MAX(COALESCE(t_pcu.pcu, NULL)) AS pcu FROM t_pcu FULL JOIN t_incr ON t_pcu.logymd = t_incr.logymd AND t_pcu.point = t_incr.point GROUP BY t_pcu.point ) t ) t ) SELECT logymd, point, online_num, pcu, acu FROM t_all WHERE point <= ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, floor( ( hour(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) ) / 300 ), 512 ) ) ORDER BY logymd, point ) AS tmp GROUP BY logymd, point

pay_channel_type, CASE WHEN pay_channel_config = 'unknown' THEN 'unknown' ELSE sub_pay_channel_raw END AS sub_pay_channel_config_source FROM t_charge_config ), t_charge_filter AS ( SELECT roleid, set_sql: WITH match_end_cnt AS( SELECT point, SUM(CASE WHEN pvptype IN(1, 2, 4) AND quit_reason <> 15 THEN success ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt, count(CASE WHEN pvptype IN (1, 2, 4) AND quit_reason <> 15 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS battle_cnt FROM ( SELECT logymd, appname, granularity_type, date_type, country, pvptype, quit_reason, success, matchid, point FROM mt_ads_realtime.ads_realtime_match_end_detail_di) a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT region, country_type, definition_type, country_code FROM mt_dim.dim_country WHERE ${definition_type} ) b ON a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} AND ${appname} AND ${granularity_type} AND ${date_type} AND ${region} AND ${country} AND ${matchid} GROUP BY point ), max_point_cte AS ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, FLOOR( ( HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) ) / 300 ), 512 ) AS max_point ) SELECT '#{data_date}' AS logymd, l.point, success_cnt, battle_cnt FROM match_end_cnt l CROSS JOIN max_point_cte m WHERE l.point <= m.max_point

set_name: mlbb实时监控-在线
set_sql: WITH point_range AS( SELECT generate_series AS point FROM TABLE(generate_series(0, 287))), online_cnt AS( SELECT point, sum(online_num) AS cnt FROM( select logymd, zoneid, big_zoneid, country, os, point, date_type, appname, granularity_type, online_num, grouping_name from hive.mt_ads.ads_decismart_realtime_zone_online) a left outer join ( select region, country_type , definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type}) b on a.country = b.country_code WHERE ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and grouping_name = 'all' and ${big_zoneid} and ${zoneid} and ${os} and ${region} and ${country} and ${channel} GROUP BY point), max_point_cte AS ( SELECT IF( ${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT_EACH}, FLOOR( ( HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 3600 + MINUTE(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')) * 60 + SECOND(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))) / 300), 512 ) AS max_point ) SELECT '#{data_date}' as logymd, r.point, l.cnt AS point_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(l.cnt, 0)) OVER ( ORDER BY r.point ASC) AS day_cnt FROM point_range r LEFT JOIN online_cnt l ON r.point = l.point CROSS JOIN max_point_cte m WHERE r.point <= m.max_point

set_name: 实时指标卡——活跃
set_sql:
select
		logymd,
		region,
		country,
		network,
		max(day_cnt) as day_cnt
	from
			mlbb.realtime_login_test a
	left outer join (
		select
			region,
			country_type ,
			definition_type ,
			country_code
		from
			mlbb.dim_country_new
		where
			definition_type = 0 ) b on
		a.country = b.country_code
	where
		${appname}
		and ${logymd}
		and ${granularity_type}
		and ${date_type}
		and ${region}
		and ${country}
		and point <= (
			SELECT
				if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT} , floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512))
	group by logymd,region,country,network

set_name: 实时分国家数据——收入
set_sql: select logymd ${pushdown_dims}, max(day_amt) as day_amt from mt_ads_realtime.realtime_charge_test  a  left outer join ( select region, country_type ,definition_type , country_code from mt_dim.dim_country where ${definition_type} ) b on a.country = b.country_code where  point <= (SELECT if(${IS_USE_CURRENT_POINT} , floor((hour(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 3600 + minute(CONVERT_TZ(now(),@@system_time_zone, '-08:00'))* 60 + second(CONVERT_TZ(now(), @@system_time_zone, '-08:00')))/ 300), 512)) and ${logymd} and ${appname} and ${granularity_type} and ${date_type} and ${country} and ${region} group by logymd ${pushdown_dims}
